metadata.scenario: A caller asks for details on the facility's hours of operation and location accessibility. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Helen Johnson. I hope you’re doing well! Hi Helen! I'm doing well, thank you. How about you? I’m good, thanks! I wanted to ask about your hours of operation and if the facility is accessible. Absolutely! Our hours are Monday to Friday from 7 AM to 7 PM, Saturday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and Sundays are for on-call emergencies only. Great! And is it easy to access the facility? Yes, we’re located at 2847 North Ridge Road, Suite 205 in Wichita. It’s ground level with accessible parking right out front. That’s good to hear. Sometimes it can be challenging for clients. I completely understand. We try to ensure it’s as convenient as possible for everyone. I appreciate that. I'm also wondering if there are any additional services available that might help me. We offer several services, including skilled nursing, medication management, and even post-surgery recovery care. I might be interested in post-surgery recovery care since I’ve had some complications. That could be very beneficial for you! The pricing ranges from $85 to $110 for 1 to 3 hours of specialized care. That sounds reasonable. I’d like to discuss that further. Of course! I can have our Care Coordinator, Lisa, give you a call to go over your specific needs. That would be wonderful. I know she can help me with the care plan too. Sure thing! I’ll have her reach out to you today. Thank you, Margaret! That really helps. You’re welcome, Helen! Is there anything else I can assist you with while I have you on the line? No, I think that covers it for now. Great! I hope you have a wonderful day, and we’ll be in touch soon. Thank you, Margaret! Bye! Bye!
